shortBulletSummary: US Senate Blocks CLARITY Act, a key crypto regulatory bill, impacting market structure clarity.
Bitcoin fell to around $75K, and Ethereum dropped below $2,400, amid broad crypto market selling.
Over $667 million in crypto long positions were liquidated in 24 hours due to market downturns.
A 92% chance of a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike adds significant pressure to risk assets like crypto.
The overall market sentiment remains "Neutral" with the index at 47-51, despite recent price declines.
